page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8ise.xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance configured with 4 dedicated vCPUs and 16.0 GB of system memory. Powered by an Intel Xeon 8475B processor running at a base clock speed of 2.7 GHz on the x86_64 architecture, this instance utilizes the KVM hypervisor to deliver dedicated compute resources. The memory configuration provides 4.0 GB of RAM per core, maintaining a balanced resource ratio.

This instance does not include local storage, requiring the attachment of external cloud storage volumes for persistent data. It features a baseline network bandwidth of 4 Gbps and does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses. There are no integrated hardware accelerators or GPUs, which limits its applicability for workloads requiring parallel processing or local high-speed storage.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and balanced memory-to-vCPU ratio make this instance a stable option for workloads requiring consistent compute performance without the overhead of specialized hardware. It is designed for general-purpose workloads, including web serving, application hosting, microservices, and development environments that do not demand high-speed local disk I/O or GPU acceleration.
